name: Zukk'ash Report
label: Quest
description: Hadoken Swiftstrider says you have done doubly well against the Zukk'ash insects menacing Camp Mojache, but the danger is far from over. One last favor…
intro: Hadoken Swiftstrider says you have done doubly well against the Zukk'ash insects menacing Camp Mojache, but the danger is far from over. One last favor for the Horde: carry a document recording everything learned about the Zukk'ash to Orgrimmar, to Zilzibin Drumlore.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You've done doubly well in addressing the threat that the Zukk'ash insects pose to Camp Mojache. The threat these things pose is far from over, and I'd like to ask you for one last task on behalf of the Horde.

This is a document that details all the information we have learned about these Zukk'ash insects. I want you to deliver it to Zilzibin Drumlore in the Drag of Orgrimmar. He's an expert on alien creatures like these; I hope he can do something with the lore we've obtained.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Greetings friend... You look as though you are on urgent business. Is there something I can help you with?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, I've been expecting this. These creatures you faced... They are an ancient threat that the Horde continues to choose to ignore. Hadoken was wise to bring this - and you - to me.

The Zukk'ash are nothing more than creatures called the silithid. Some would think that they are a mindless nuisance, but let me assure you - they are a far, far worse threat than anything the Alliance could muster.
If you're willing and strong enough, I could use your aid in bringing this threat to light.
